_comment: The platform trial credit's owner-trust rule, asserted byte-for-byte by BOTH implementations: packages/api/src/ee/services/platform-llm.test.ts (TypeScript, the control plane that advertises the credit) and apps/gateway/crates/ee/ee/src/platform_llm.rs (Rust, the gateway that injects it). A divergence would let one side offer free credit the other refuses, or the reverse. Every address here is made up.
